But B is a live real argument (GPS jamming and spoofing at sea) and the fourth option is this option's coherent negation, so the distractors are substantive positions, not filler.

findings.note: Filler distractor: Swedish lighthouses have been automated for decades, so there is no keepers' union to drive the resistance. Eliminable without the passage.

findings.quote: Under mer än tvåtusen år var fyren en av civilisationens mest oumbärliga byggnader.
findings.note: Length class sits outside the authentic LÄS range: 118 words over two paragraphs, against 168 distinct authentic LÄS passages running 199–1500+ words (median 672); the short exemplar var-2015-verb2-LÄS-016 is roughly 450 words. A two-paragraph LÄS text would not sit unremarked in a provpass. The prose itself is good HP register, which is why this is not lethal.

findings.quote: Det saknar helt känslomässiga inslag.
findings.note: This option is labelled 'A', duplicating the first option's letter, and there is no 'D'. Mechanical rather than register, but an examinee would notice it on the page.

findings.quote: Pamfletten och sociala medier fyller likartade funktioner.
findings.note: The 'Luther's pamphlets were the viral social media of their day' analogy is a commonplace (Pettegree, Standage); a solver picks it without reading a word.

findings.quote: Boktryckarkonsten uppfanns i Wittenberg.
findings.note: Fails the stem's own requirement - it is not a comparison between the Reformation and the present - and is factually wrong (Mainz, Gutenberg). Eliminable on stem-type mismatch alone, with no domain knowledge.

findings.quote: spreds nu på veckor över hela det tyskspråkiga området
findings.note: class 6: bare 'pa veckor' in an affirmative clause is a collocation miss — in Swedish that frame belongs to negated duration ('har inte sovit pa veckor'), so the sentence garden-paths. Native alternative: 'spreds nu pa nagra veckor over hela det tysksprakiga omradet'.

findings.quote: Att gemensam förvaltning kan fungera hållbart med rätt institutioner.
findings.note: This is Elinor Ostrom's Nobel-winning thesis against Hardin; anyone who knows the commons literature picks it blind. B and D are the opposing live positions (privatisation, state control) and C a lesser critique, so the distractors are substantive scholarly stances and the passage genuinely grounds the item. World knowledge, not passage independence.

findings.quote: tydliga gränser, regler som de berörda själva utformade, och trovärdiga sätt att bestraffa den som fuskade
findings.note: class 2: serial (Oxford) comma before 'och' in a three-item list is an English punctuation habit; Swedish list convention omits it. A Swedish copy editor would delete the second comma.

findings.quote: Uppfunna traditioner uppstår ofta i tider av snabb förändring.
findings.note: This is Hobsbawm's central thesis in The Invention of Tradition, and C is refuted by the well-known Trevor-Roper account of the clan tartan as a 19th-century construction. Domain knowledge, not form, does the work; the distractors are substantive misreadings a passage would correct.

findings.quote: En tradition fyller sin funktion oavsett hur gammal den är.
findings.note: Option B reproduces this passage sentence verbatim, and option A ('Uppfunna traditioner uppstår ofta i tider av snabb förändring') restates 'Sådana traditioner uppstår ofta i tider av snabb förändring' almost word for word. HP options sit in paraphrase register — every option in var-2019-verb1-LÄS-018 and host-2020-verb2-LÄS-020 is reworded away from the passage's own wording.

findings.quote: Vilket av följande påståenden får stöd i texten?
findings.note: The authentic version of this stem family always carries a ranking delimiter — 'Vilket påstående överensstämmer bäst med texten?' and its 10 corpus siblings all use 'bäst'. Without it, and with two verbatim-lift options, the item reads as generated rather than set.

findings.quote: På grund av dåtidens tillverkningsmetod.
findings.note: The 'glass flows' myth is widely debunked in popular science; a solver who knows crown-glass manufacture picks this without the passage.

findings.quote: Därför att glas är en vätska i rumstemperatur.
findings.note: This option and B assert the same claim at premise and consequence level - if glass were a room-temperature liquid, the slow downward flow would follow - so neither can be the unique key. That mutual entailment halves the field from form alone, no domain knowledge required.

findings.quote: Att det finns odokumenterad kunskap inom praktisk naturvård.
findings.note: The stem states the authors cite three named studies; citing studies cannot demonstrate that knowledge is undocumented, so this falls to the stem alone. A fails the same way - three single-topic studies are not systematic reviews. Two of four eliminable on form with no domain knowledge, leaving C and D undecided.

findings.quote: Att det sker en tillvänjningsprocess som förskju- ter tidigare uppfattningar om rätt och fel.
findings.note: The stem quotes 'sluttande plan', whose standard meaning just is a habituation process shifting earlier moral boundaries, so a solver who knows the idiom picks this. A, B and D are substantive variants of the slippery-slope argument in the euthanasia debate, so the passage still decides which Norlen means.

findings.quote: Etniskt splittrade samhällen.
findings.note: Knowledge of Arab Spring causation picks this: youth unemployment, inequality and corruption are the drivers of an uprising, while ethnic fragmentation is the classic obstacle to a unified one. From form alone the four options are parallel noun phrases with no visible asymmetry - the 'three cluster, one stands apart' reading here is domain reasoning in a structural costume, so flag, not kill.
